decision: held: exact remaining item (Dr. Pham fifth ruling, 2026-10-28): the trial 37976892 names only 'a multi-enzyme blend obtained from fungal fermentation' (200 mg per capsule, 2 capsules/day, 2 months). Exact-brand credit requires identifying the study material and its enzyme activities, from the full paper's Methods/materials section or written manufacturer correspondence, and matching them to a retail formula. The brand 'Poolzyme Multi' from an earlier author-shared copy is not verified. The CC-BY full text (https://doi.org/10.1016/j.biopha.2023.115858) blocked automated access this session. Once identity and activities are verified, the encoding is: approve the context as scoring-eligible for functional dyspepsia; applicability {require_source_label_form true, required_form_terms [verified brand/formula name], supported_outcomes ['digestive'], source_pmids ['37976892']}; drop record-level scoring_eligible with a notes citation.
summary: 37976892 abstract: 120 adults aged 18-59 with functional dyspepsia randomized to 2 capsules/day of a 200 mg fungal multi-enzyme blend or placebo for 2 months; the primary outcome (NDI-SF quality of life) and secondary pain (VAS) and sleep (PSQI) scores improved without side effects. Credit is ruled for the exact formula only; isolated enzymes and absorption claims get none.

identity.standardization: Five-enzyme fungal fermentation preparation containing amylase, protease, lactase, cellulase and lipase; samples supplied by Giellepi. Exact activity specifications remain a preparation-correspondence requirement.

population.description: 120 adults aged18–59 with functional dyspepsia (63men,57women), randomized1:1; registry specifies RomeIV diagnosis.

dose.administration_frequency: One200mg capsule beforelunch and one200mg capsule beforedinner.
dose.reported_regimen: Two200mg whole-Poolzyme-Multi capsules daily for60days, lunch and dinner.

normalization.basis: Two capsules/day multiplied by200mg whole-enzyme preparation per capsule=400mg/day; this does not determine individual enzyme masses or activity equivalence.
